name: source-observed-party-resolution-v55
sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS party_coverage_bank_resolution_no_update; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS party_coverage_bank_resolution_no_delete; ALTER TABLE party_coverage_bank_resolution_events RENAME TO party_coverage_bank_resolution_events_v54; CREATE TABLE party_coverage_bank_resolution_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),reconciliation_id TEXT NOT NULL,journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),transaction_hash TEXT NOT NULL,journal_entry_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(journal_entry_hash)=64),resolution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(resolution_type IN ('linked','no_external','unresolved_external_party')),document_id INTEGER REFERENCES documents(id),document_sha256 TEXT CHECK(document_sha256 IS NULL OR length(document_sha256)=64),party_id TEXT,party_role TEXT,evidence_reference TEXT NOT NULL,rationale TEXT NOT NULL,next_action TEXT,plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),actor TEXT NOT NULL,principal TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,CHECK((resolution_type='linked' AND document_id IS NULL AND document_sha256 IS NULL AND party_id IS NOT NULL AND party_role IS NOT NULL AND next_action IS NULL) OR (resolution_type='no_external' AND document_id IS NULL AND document_sha256 IS NULL AND party_id IS NULL AND party_role IS NULL AND next_action IS NULL) OR (resolution_type='unresolved_external_party' AND document_id IS NOT NULL AND document_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND party_id IS NULL AND party_role IS NULL AND length(trim(next_action)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000))); INSERT INTO party_coverage_bank_resolution_events(id,bank_transaction_id,reconciliation_id,journal_entry_id,transaction_hash,journal_entry_hash,resolution_type,document_id,document_sha256,party_id,party_role,evidence_reference,rationale,next_action,plan_hash,actor,principal,created_at) SELECT id,bank_transaction_id,reconciliation_id,journal_entry_id,transaction_hash,journal_entry_hash,resolution_type,NULL,NULL,party_id,party_role,evidence_reference,rationale,NULL,plan_hash,actor,principal,created_at FROM party_coverage_bank_resolution_events_v54; DROP TABLE party_coverage_bank_resolution_events_v54; CREATE TRIGGER party_coverage_bank_resolution_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON party_coverage_bank_resolution_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'party coverage bank resolutions are append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER party_coverage_bank_resolution_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON party_coverage_bank_resolution_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'party coverage bank resolutions are append-only'); END;
